sources.title: MG current offers
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Current offers, prices in the order standard driveaway then driveaway after cashback: MG4 EV Urban Essence 43 $31,990 / $29,990 ($2,000 cashback); MG4 EV Urban Essence 54 $34,990 / $32,990 ($2,000); MG4 EV Essence 64 Drive Away Offer $39,990; MG4 EV XPOWER Drive Away Offer $47,990; MGS5 EV Essence 49kWh $41,990 / $39,990 ($2,000); MGS5 EV Essence 62kWh $46,990 / $44,990 ($2,000); MGS6 EV Essence RWD $49,990 / $48,990 ($1,000); MGS6 EV Essence AWD $56,990 / $55,990 ($1,000); IM5 and IM6 Premium $60,990 / $57,990, Platinum $67,990 / $64,990, Performance $77,990 / $74,990 ($3,000 cashback plus $500 accessories; card says offer ends 30 November). Other cards say offer ends 31 December. Terms expanded on the page: '*' prices are driveaway without options (12 months registration and CTP, maximum dealer delivery and estimated stamp duty); offers at participating MG dealers sold and delivered between 01 Nov and 31 Dec 2026, while stocks last; excludes fleet, government and rental buyers. Cashback is redeemed at point of sale as a deduction from the purchase price and is not combinable with other offers (IM5 and IM6 cashback combines with the $500 EV Accessories Bonus).
